out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Continuous Towel System
violations.observation: Observed that the continuous towel system used at the handwashing sink is not providing clean towels and/or is not operational. The paper towel dispenser by the produce prep sink was observed non-operational, paper towels observed on table near the handsink.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the continuous towel system. Continuous towel systems shall supply the user with a clean towel to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Please repair paper towel dispenser.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: The cutting board(s) are heavily scratched and scored. The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. Please obtain new cutting boards by the next inspection.
